storylines: GORD: It's not nothing. It's also one game. I'll say this much — the Flyers are four and four with a plus-one goal differential. We're one and seven and one, minus sixteen. On paper this is not a matchup that favors us. But this team has beaten expectations before on the road, and if van Reede and McKinley are running like they were tonight, I wouldn't want to be the team telling them it can't happen. CASEY: That might be the nicest thing you've ever said about this group. GORD: Don't push it. CASEY: Village People, Sunday November 8th, ten-twenty in the morning, Canlan, home ice. The win column is open. Ice & Easy — we'll see you Sunday.
